fact: The Ministry of Communications and Technology seeks an external consulting firm to design, deploy and operationalize the Government API Gateway, SSO and National Digital Government Portal, with six months post-go-live stabilization and handover of source code to MoCT (World Bank EA-RDIP, submissions due 29 October 2026).
title: Design, Deployment and Operationalization of the Government API Gateway, Government Single Sign-On (SSO) and National Digital Government Portal
publisher: Ministry of Communications and Technology, Federal Republic of Somalia (REOI, via TenderNation)
